summary: Name the runtime readiness waiter for current pending work

replay.detail: No claims or projections change; this is a read-only annotation of existing owner and work state.

schema.detail: No table or index changes. Single and batched owner hydration also reads the existing run phase without extra queries.

rules.detail: Readiness evaluation and priority are unchanged. Partially progressed runs now expose the same runtime owner through operational reasons.

compatibility.detail: Current pending work includes waiting for daemon/runtime to evaluate readiness in the existing string reasons list. It does not promise eligibility or predicate evaluation. Ready, terminal, superseded and cleanup-owned work does not carry this waiter; existing blockers remain visible.

downtime.detail: No startup migration or replay is required.

manual.detail: The runtime owner appears in normal CLI and client work reads without a repair or person action.

recovery.detail: Promotion removes the waiter automatically. No new durable state needs recovery.
